TEXT:
After parting with Sena, we returned to the station 
once again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
S-Somehow, that ended taking a fair amount of 
time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's all because you said that you needed some 
recharging.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Hmm, at this point, watching a movie is impossible, 
huh.
She just brushed what I said aside.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Shall we go look at some clothes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Oh, you say good things every once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But no.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I told you there was somewhere I wanted to go 
today, right?

Now that I think about it, she did say something like 
that.
So it wasn't about watching a movie.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Where to?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: The supermarket.

The destination that came out of her mouth was 
way too unexpected.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: The supermarket?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yes, the supermarket.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
By supermarket, you mean... going to buy 
groceries?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What other reason would there be to go there?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That's true, but...... you, going to the supermarket, 
huh.
It didn't suit her.

Besides, it wasn't a place you would go to on a 
date.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, if you want to go there, I'm fine with it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah. Carry the bags, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, yeah.
I obediently responded to my girlfriend's request.
The next morning.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ......Zzz, zzz.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ouch!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What the?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey, you awake?
